equity.level_reason: Percentages of an SDOH-type outcome (lacking social and emotional support) are reported by disability status and sex, but only set side by side with CIs; no difference or ratio is computed, so the level is capped at 2.

level_alternative.reason: Disability is defined by functional limitation and not explicitly framed as social position or access, leaving only sex and age.

notes: The 'higher' and 'similar' claims likely rest on unstated tests or CI comparisons, but the QuickStats names no test, p-value or overlap rule, so no procedure is recorded. NHIS survey weighting is not stated, so it is not recorded.
view_issues: Difference claims ('higher', 'similar') are made without a stated testing method; only CIs on error bars are mentioned.
